blocks.orig: Selous River Camp is beautifully situated on the Rufiji River adjacent to the Julius Nyerere National Park. Here you sleep in traditionally built ‘mudhuts’ with thatched roofs and ensuite bathrooms along the river bank, allowing you to fall asleep with the sounds of honking hippos in the river and the call of bush babies above you in the trees. The riverside swimming pool, sun terrace, bar and dining area complete the picture – especially when the sun sets to paint the whole area in the most beautiful hues of orange, pink and purple.
blocks.html: Selous River Camp has a lovely setting on the Rufiji River, right next to Julius Nyerere National Park. You stay in traditionally built ‘mudhuts’ with thatched roofs and en-suite bathrooms on the riverbank, where you drift off to the honking of hippos in the water and the calls of bush babies in the trees overhead. A riverside swimming pool, sun terrace, bar and dining area round things off – above all at sunset, when the whole area turns glorious shades of orange, pink and purple.
